Heavy Monsoon Rains Expected Across Multiple Indian States

Several Indian states, including Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra, are on alert for heavy monsoon rains. Satellite imagery shows dense clouds over Gujarat, indicating the active southwest monsoon. The forecast raises concerns about potential waterlogging and flooding in affected areas, particularly in Uttarakhand where a four-day heavy rainfall alert has been issued.
